---
name: Bounded work item
about: Propose a useful outcome with explicit acceptance and verification
---

# Work item

## Outcome

Describe the problem and the observable result.

## Scope and non-goals

Define what this item includes and excludes. Identify the owner and relevant context.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Describe an observable completion condition.

## Validation

Name the checks or evidence for each criterion, including failure cases where relevant.
For a defect, give reproduction steps and expected versus actual behavior.

## Dependencies and decisions

Link real prerequisites. Identify missing policy or authority and what would unblock work.
Select the milestone and priority during triage. Do not assign an epic as an open-ended task.
